newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police seize Nazi books in raid on shop.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police seize Nazi books in raid on shop.

text.p: Spanish police said on Thursday they had seized 7,000 books and other material espousing Nazism and denying the Holocaust in a raid on a Barcelona bookshop.
The bookshop owner, Pedro Varela, 39, was arrested and later released on bail, said a police spokesman.
The books were written in German, English and Spanish and most of them had been published in South America.
The police also found flags with swastikas and xenophobic videos.
A new Spanish law makes it a crime to defend genocide.
